reminders.text: Time to send Joel the feedback: include her feedback list, newest first, in her short versions where there are any, ready for her to forward
Stop snacking after 10 pm (at 8 pm: anything still wanted tonight, have it soon; at 10 pm: kitchen's closed for tonight)
Poster due tomorrow: finish what's left
Lunch work: montage last day, then poster cut + stick
Poster: last touches, done tonight
Breakfast nudge: time to eat and log breakfast; where today stands against my goals
Lunch nudge: time to eat and log lunch; where today stands, what's left, and what I could eat
Dinner nudge: time to eat and log dinner; where today stands, what's left, and what I could eat
Take your antidepressant before bed

Check her calendar copy for today's workouts first: any workout there counts as done and is logged, said back in one line. Then ask only whether she did anything else today (sets and reps if she has them; a walk or the ankle routine counts). Nothing on the calendar: ask what workout or exercises she did today
Only if yesterday has no workout in her record and none on her calendar copy: ask what workout she did yesterday. If yesterday's workout is on her calendar, it counts as done: log it and send nothing
Her week of workouts as a phone-friendly list, Mon to Sun: each day and what she did, as logged, with workouts on her calendar copy counted as done. Weeks from Mon 9 Nov 2026 only

My week so far, Monday to today, one line a day: calories in, calories out (lower end, kept apart) and the balance against my 1,200; restarts each Monday. On Sundays also: this week's total in and total out; this month's weeks so far, each with total in and out (restarts each month; a week counts in the month its Sunday falls in); this year's months so far, each with total in and out (restarts each year)
Tidy OT hours document: last chance, finish tonight
Montage: finish before the weekend ends
Dance class at 12 pm
Portfolio: submit it today
Sent at her ask, now: her workout week 9 to 15 Nov again, with Sunday's dance added
